mintAuthority.summary: VCHF minting remains controlled by VNXManager 0xCdB386...c9AE and its sole observed minter, EOA 0x7b0c15...9403. The Ethereum transparent proxy is administered by custom VNXProxyAdmin 0x817f8a...8165: upgrade() and upgradeAndCall() require role 1 in separate VNXManager 0x2B535E...114b, whose role 1 currently has no bearers. Self-administered role 0 is held by two independent EOAs, 0x45a149...545a and 0xAcC56E...311A, either of which can grant itself role 1 without delay; 0x45a149...545a also owns VNXProxyAdmin and can redirect the proxy admin through changeProxyAdmin().

controls.label: VCHF VNX token proxy
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081, proxy EIP-1967 slot confirms implementation 0xd1d7193ce1aa7808d577058f48ef8289fc2f81fc. Storage slot 0x33 confirms rbacManager = VNXManager 0xCdB3867935247049e87c38eA270edD305D84c9AE. vnxc.sol source: mint() gated by isMinter() = rbacManager.hasRole(msg.sender, minterRoleId). 118 mint() calls (selector 0x40c10f19) confirmed successful from EOA 0x7b0c15f39cd987a7d3f5d8d10b57ac6d633e9403, the sole minter.

controls.label: VNXManager RBAC contract
controls.evidence: VNXManager source (contract name confirmed via Blockscout): custom RBAC with roles[] array (length=2: Superadmin=0, one other role). At block 25295081, owner() = 0x7b0c15f39cd987a7d3f5d8d10b57ac6d633e9403 (EOA, confirmed by eth_getCode returning empty). EOA holds Superadmin role (role 0) which controls configureMinter. EOA is also confirmed as the active minter via 118 successful mint txns.

controls.label: VNX minter / VNXManager owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081, eth_getCode returns empty (confirmed EOA). This address issued 118 successful VCHF mint() calls on Ethereum and owns VNXManager (owner() confirmed). Issuer-context EOA; off-chain MPC/HSM indistinguishable on-chain, does not block verified.

controls.label: VNXProxyAdmin RBAC manager
bypassSurfaces: Self-administered role 0 administers upgrade role 1, so either role-0 bearer can grant itself direct upgrade access without delay.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531301, VNXProxyAdmin referenced this VNXManager for its upgrade authorization. Direct upgrade() and upgradeAndCall() require manager role 1, which had zero current bearers. Role 1 was administered by self-administered role 0, whose two current bearers were EOAs 0x45a149f42FF0B77D148d05904Dd7577dF36A545a and 0xAcC56EBcC391108A725F269FDD82D6cbe65b311A.

controls.label: VNXProxyAdmin role-0 superadmin / Ownable owner EOA 0x45a1...545a
bypassSurfaces: As a self-administered role-0 bearer, this EOA can grant itself direct upgrade role 1 without delay.
As VNXProxyAdmin's Ownable owner, this EOA can call changeProxyAdmin() and redirect the token proxy to another admin; owner() alone does not authorize upgrade() or upgradeAndCall().
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531301, this code-empty EOA was both a role-0 bearer in VNXProxyAdmin's RBAC manager and VNXProxyAdmin's Ownable owner. Verified source shows owner-only changeProxyAdmin(), but upgrade() and upgradeAndCall() instead require RBAC role 1. Role 1 had zero bearers; this EOA can still grant itself role 1 through self-administered role 0, or use changeProxyAdmin() to create a separate indirect code-change path.

controls.label: VNXProxyAdmin role-0 superadmin EOA 0xAcC5...311A
bypassSurfaces: As a self-administered role-0 bearer, this EOA can grant itself direct upgrade role 1 without delay.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531301, this code-empty EOA was the second role-0 bearer in VNXProxyAdmin's RBAC manager. Upgrade role 1 had zero bearers, but self-administered role 0 administers role 1, so this EOA can grant itself direct upgrade authority without delay.

review.evidence: Mint-path findings remain supported at Ethereum block 25295081: token rbacManager 0xCdB386...c9AE and 118 successful mint() calls identify EOA 0x7b0c15...9403 as the sole observed minter. Upgrade-path review at block 25531301 confirmed VNXProxyAdmin 0x817f8a...8165 as the EIP-1967 admin and showed that upgrade() and upgradeAndCall() require role 1 in manager 0x2B535E...114b rather than Ownable owner(). Role 1 had zero bearers, while self-administered role 0 had two code-empty EOA bearers, 0x45a149...545a and 0xAcC56E...311A, either able to self-grant role 1 without delay. The first EOA also owned VNXProxyAdmin and could independently redirect the proxy admin through changeProxyAdmin(). Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): AREVA General Auditing and Trust Company Limited issued annual agreed-upon-procedures reports for 2023 and 2024, but the latest covers 2024-12-31 and was published 2025-02-05; the expected 2025 annual report is overdue as of 2026-07-15, so current recurring reconciliation is not established. Liechtenstein FMA's register matches VNX Commodities AG only as a TT Service Provider, not a prudential EMT issuer.
